# LazyBridge

> Python agent framework where everything is a tool. An agent is Engine + Tools + State; functions, other agents and whole Plan pipelines all go in `tools=[...]`. Engines are swappable: Claude Code and Codex (on a subscription login) or provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, LiteLLM) behind the same interface. Apache-2.0, Python 3.11+.

Cloud Claude and Codex dispatch lives in the LazyTools code bridge (Alpha, `--where cloud`), not in Core.

Install: `pip install lazybridge`. Integrations (MCP, connectors, async coding bridge) live in LazyTools, installed from GitHub: `pip install "lazytoolkit[mcp] @ git+https://github.com/selvaz/LazyTools@v0.10.6"` (the PyPI name `lazytoolkit` is a placeholder; do not `pip install lazytoolkit`).

Minimal example (one engine writes, the other reviews):

```python
from lazybridge import Agent, ClaudeCodeEngine, CodexEngine

reviewer = Agent(name="codex-reviewer", engine=CodexEngine(
    system='Start with "approved" or "rejected: <reason>".'))
writer = Agent(name="claude-writer", engine=ClaudeCodeEngine(),
               verify=reviewer, max_verify=3)
print(writer("Draft a function that blocks weekend deployment.").text())
```
